title: Why 165 Volcanoes Put America Ahead of Indonesia
hook: America has 165 volcanoes, beating the country everyone expects.
closing: Fame can distort scale, so the count matters more than reputation.
question: Which country would you have guessed?

segments.say: The United States leads with 165 volcanoes, while famous Indonesia ranks behind it.
Alaska alone has 130 volcanoes, making one state larger than Indonesia's entire count.
The Ring of Fire holds 75 percent of active volcanoes, linking Alaska, Japan, and Indonesia.
